{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "note_finding = lambda finding, implication: print(f'⚠️ FINDING: {finding}\n   IMPLICATION: {implication}')

# Check for duplicate orders
if sales_df['order_id'].duplicated().any():
    note_finding('Duplicate order_ids found', 'Must deduplicate to avoid double-counting')
else:
    note_finding('No duplicate order_ids', 'Safe to proceed with counts')

# Check for invalid statuses
invalid_statuses = set(sales_df['status']) - {'completed', 'refunded'}
if invalid_statuses:
    note_finding(f'Unexpected status values: {invalid_statuses}', 'May indicate data quality issue')
else:
    note_finding('All statuses are valid', 'No data quality issues detected')

# Check for non-numeric revenue values
if sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum() > 0:
    note_finding(f'{sales_df["revenue"].isnull().sum()} rows have invalid revenue', 'Must exclude these from revenue-based calculations')
else:
    note_finding('All revenue values are valid', 'No missing revenue data')"}}
</tool_call>
